title: Support refund requests
issue: The support console gets a single entry point for refunds. Add `process_refund_request(payment, amount, requested_by, at)` in a new module `ledgerly/support.py`. `amount` is the text the support agent typed (for example "49.99"; amounts with more than two decimals are rounded to the cent), `requested_by` is the agent's user id and `at` is when the request was made. Only captured payments can be refunded, the amount must be positive, and the total refunded must never exceed the captured amount. Apply the refund to the payment (keep the running total in `payment.refunded_amount`; set `payment.status` to `"refunded"` once the full amount has been refunded) and return the payment.
